title: Judge Suggests Trump Mail-In Voting Rules Could Cause ‘Major Disenfranchisement’
summary: Judge Indira Talwani said the Postal Service appeared to be trying a haphazard “experiment” with a new rule that could result in valid ballots being tossed.
body_markdown: Judge Indira Talwani said the Postal Service appeared to be trying a haphazard “experiment” with a new rule that could result in valid ballots being tossed.
